description_en: Queries directories on which delete operations were recently performed
description_zh: 查询最近执行过删除操作的目录
name: ListRecentlyRecycledDirectories

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

If a single query does not return all directories, the NextToken parameter is returned with a value. You can specify a valid NextToken value in subsequent requests to continue the query
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识，首次查询无需传入。

如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的目录，则返回NextToken不为空。您可以在查询中上传正确的NextToken继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of directories to return per query.

Valid values: 10 to 1000.

Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询返回目录的个数。

取值范围：10~1000

默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

Entries.description_en: The information about directories on which delete operations were recently performed
Entries.description_zh: 最近执行过删除操作的目录信息

LastDeleteTime.description_en: The time when the most recent delete operation was performed on the directory. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
LastDeleteTime.description_zh: 该目录最近一次执行删除操作的时间。按照 ISO 8601 标准表示，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Path.description_en: The absolute path of the directory

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token for the next page.

If a single query does not return all directories, the NextToken parameter is returned with a value. You can specify a valid NextToken value in subsequent requests to continue the query
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。

如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的目录，则返回NextToken不为空。您可以在查询中上传正确的NextToken继续查询
